The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KARUWALAGASWEWA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A (1) (a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of resignation;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Jathika Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Ilandari Purage Wikramapala the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A (1) (a) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon the member of that No. 1 - Pahala Puliyankulama of Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the local authorities elections ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Nawaratna Muththalage Neel Nawaratna to fill such vacancy;

NOW THEREFORE Sirinivasage Lakshitha Ruwan Jayanayake returning officer of the Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of selection 66A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Nawaratne Muththalage Neel Nawarathna was elected as the member of the No.- 1 Pahala Puliyankulama of Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha. S. L. R. Jayanayake,Returning Officer,Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha.17th June 2025,District Election Office,Puttalam.
